snippet.title: Balance: Umbilical Wake - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4874170/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer_description&utm_campaign=wishlist

Step into a fisherman’s recurring nightmare of living on a levitating platform that tilts with every move.

Connected to a large mechanical box through an umbilical cord, learn the world’s rules, solve its puzzles, catch fish, and inject them into your navel to wake up.
But the nightmare keeps returning until your child’s birth begins to reshape it.
